title: Dispatching back to the showroom
intro: A garment that has passed quality check is available for return to the showroom.

steps.title: Dispatch the garment to the showroom
steps.body: Open Dispatch in the workshop. The Ready tab lists all garments that have passed quality check. Select Dispatch (1). Where dispatching this garment would leave another garment from the same order at the workshop, a warning is displayed before the dispatch is recorded.
